programmeSource.aliasPolicy: Existing complete UI translations are authoritative for shared controls/answers. The data module is a generated snapshot, guarded against the current locale values. Source-paired isiZulu call sites retain their own exact previous wording. Preparing… and skipped have pending English keys, so they are not reused as native authority. The complete Not sure response uses soilConditionUnknown: its exact English label and first-person uncertainty meaning match this response.

englishSourcePolicy: English inputs, report records and unknown/private evidence remain unchanged. Original context-specific isiZulu is passed by its existing caller. The legacy PDF and metric maps are retained exactly. Explicitly authored English review sentences are recorded as new review-status sources, not as existing UI literals.
fontPolicy: Regional exports reuse bundled Noto Sans and reportPdfText. Default English export keeps Helvetica/pdfSafe behavior. Source report records and arrays are not mutated. Native title/review header rows are measured before the body.
remaining: Final release-note/registered broader and full checks; push finished branch once.
Main site-analysis lib/report-pdf.ts still needs Unicode font and native furniture throughout its actual exported pages.
TrainingFeedback entry form and MelResponse/saved-feedback language validators remain en/zu only. Report findings/read presentation is translated here.
Wider app workflows, older update history, social/share metadata and Study/manual media remain under the whole-app goal.
